svg.title: Figure 4: Delivery handling and finalization
svg.desc: Deliveries are preserved in Bronze, parsed and validated. Invalid deliveries go to quarantine with payload and rejection reason retained. Valid deliveries feed Silver, which applies an event-time watermark and duplicate suppression and flags late valid records. After replay completion, Gold is rebuilt from Bronze by exact source identity and can include records omitted from Silver, but cannot restore readings never received. Finalization checks delivery accounting, replay completion and terminal offsets, Gold and Hadoop agreement, and artifact bindings; if all pass the run can be published, otherwise publication is blocked.
